properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL — Anthony, 2026-08-04, in his own words: "I kind of like this idea of brainstorming ideas for how to solve a problem and laying out trials for how to figure out which is the best approach - maybe this is a future reflow2 skill??" Raised while brainstorming the corpus-ingest strategies (dec:idea-corpus-ingest-strategies), which is the first concrete case for it.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS, AND IT IS MORE THAN HALF — the design-space version of this shipped as BL-70 and nothing in this idea should be built without reading it first. `register_alternative` forks a `proposed` Decision into alternatives, each a pointer to that branch's own design export, GOVERNED_BY the Decision and CONTRADICTS its siblings, and it REFUSES unless the Decision is proposed — you fork an open choice, not a settled one. `analyze_alternatives` then compares the branches ON THE SAME MEASURES — design nodes, open gaps, structural defects, allocation modularity, capabilities verified, plus each branch's structural divergence from the baseline — in throwaway graphs, so it never touches the live one. Its own words are "makes alternatives comparable on measures, not advocacy", which is this idea's thesis already stated. `collapse_decision` picks the winner, moves the Decision to accepted, and SUPERSEDES the losers with OBSOLETES so the roads not taken stay on the record. `detect_gaps` fires `undecided_decision_point` once a Decision holds two or more registered alternatives, so an open fork nags and a musing does not.

THE GAP, AND IT IS SPECIFIC — reflow2 can compare DESIGNS; it cannot compare RUNS. Every measure `analyze_alternatives` reports is a property of the resulting graph's shape. None of them is a property of the PROCESS that produced it: what it cost, how long it took, how much of the corpus it covered, how much noise it raised, how many questions a human then had to answer, and whether the result was recognisable to the person who owns the material. The corpus-ingest strategies are indistinguishable on graph shape and completely different on all of those. A trial produces evidence about a PROCESS and there is nowhere in the graph to put it. That is the same hole [BL-187] names from the other side — the corpus records when something was true and nothing computes whether it still is.

THE SECOND GAP, AND IT IS THE ONE THIS PROJECT KEEPS FINDING — no skill drives the alternatives family end to end. `brainstorm` mentions `register_alternative` in passing, as the line where a musing becomes a fork. Nothing tells anyone to then run `analyze_alternatives` or `collapse_decision`. Same shape as `ingest_step`, which is built, served, verified, and named in no skill at all: a tool nobody is told to call is a tool nobody calls ([BL-154]).

HONEST COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, recorded beside the idea rather than used to kill it. (1) `dec:report-dont-judge` — a trial that picks a winner by number is arithmetic overruling a person, which is the move this project refuses everywhere else; the skill would have to REPORT the measures and leave the collapse to the human, exactly as `collapse_decision` already requires a stated winner and a rationale. (2) The api-boss's objection to PMBOK in `reflow2_feedback.md` applies here too: reflow2 is a design-coherence tool, and importing an experiment harness risks "a second, competing spine next to the golden thread". (3) Trials are expensive, and the cheapest honest version of this idea may be a SKILL over the existing tools plus a convention for recording run measures as evidence, rather than any new vocabulary — which is what the last two node-type proposals in this project both collapsed into after measurement (`Attestation` → `TemporalFact`, `Hazard` → `DesignRule`).

NOT PROMOTED, NOT SIZED, AND NOT MINE — recorded so the idea is findable and so the next session does not re-derive BL-70, which is the specific failure this session hit three times.
properties.name: OPEN — should reflow2 have a skill for "brainstorm the options, then TRIAL them and let measurement choose"?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill because Anthony floated it as a question, not a request. The load-bearing content is the survey of what BL-70 already provides: the idea is substantially built for design alternatives and genuinely missing for process trials, and that distinction is what would make it worth building rather than a second name for something that exists.
